The '''Infinite Dessication''' was a region of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that extended westward from [[Outpost Zaroshe]]. The [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|Rakatan complex]] where [[the Imprisoned One]] was kept was located in the area.
